Wade Williamson tells an intense true story on the Danny Jones podcast about the fine line between self-defense and murder. Williamson's account centers on a life-or-death choice and its legal aftermath. Jones presents it as one of the wildest stories his show has hosted.

Williamson walks through the confrontation step by step, as he remembers it. He explains what police, lawyers, and courts made of his claim to self-defense. The talk lingers on how thin the legal line can be when seconds decide everything. Thoughtful and wary listeners get a hard look at the law's grayest zone.
